scheme_name: State Medical Scholarship (Scholarship Scheme for MBBS & Allied Courses, Nursing and Paramedical Students)
other_conditions: Applicant must be selected through NEET, NSEE or State Departmental Examination only.
Applicant must be pursuing medical, nursing or paramedical courses.
Students who repeat the course (repeaters) are not eligible for an additional stipend.
Applications must be submitted online through the Common Scholarship Portal; hard‑copy applications will not be accepted.
Incomplete or unclear documents will lead to rejection of the application.
Applications submitted after the last date of submission will be rejected.
False statements or fraudulent documents may result in blacklisting and recovery of any scholarship already paid.
Applicant must provide correct bank account details; the department is not responsible for non‑receipt due to incorrect bank information.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance/scholarships are provided to eligible students based on the medical, nursing or paramedical course they are enrolled in.
